source: interface IItem { public int V { get; } }
class InterfaceHolder { public IItem? It=new Item(); }
class GenericHolder<T> { public T It; }
class StaticHolder { public static Item? It; }
class Item : IItem { public int V=3; public int Read(){return this.V;} }

class Holder { public Item? It=new Item(); public Set<int> Tags=[1].ToSet(); public bool ClearAndRead(){Item x=this.It!; this.It=null; return x.V==3;} public Item ClearAndReturn(){Item x=this.It!; this.It=null; return x;} }
class DetachedHolder { public Item? It=new Item(); }
class ComplexItem { public int V=3; public List<int> Values=[1]; public Item Child=new Item(); }
class ComplexHolder { public ComplexItem? It=new ComplexItem(); }
class MixedItem { @storage(allowed: .Session) public List<int> Memo=[1]; public int Value=3; }
class MixedHolder { public MixedItem? It=new MixedItem(); public bool ClearMixed(){List<int> xs=this.It!.Memo; MixedItem x=this.It!; this.It=null; xs.Add(2); return xs.Count==2 && x.Memo.Count==2;} }

class Bag { public List<Item?> Items=[new Item()]; public Dictionary<string,Item?> Map={"k":new Item()}; public Item? It=new Item(); public bool ClearEntry(){Item x=Items[0]!; Items[0]=null; return true;} public bool ClearMapEntry(){Item x=Map["k"]!; Map["k"]=null; return true;} public bool ClearEntryRead(){Item x=Items[0]!; Items[0]=null; return x.V==3;} public bool ReadThenClear(){bool three=It!.V==3; It=null; return three;} }
class Outer { public Holder H=new Holder(); }
class Probe {
public static Bag CreateBag(){return new Bag();}
public static Holder CreateHolder(){return new Holder();}
public static MixedHolder CreateMixedHolder(){return new MixedHolder();}
public static bool ListEntryRetain() { Bag h=new Bag(); Item x=h.Items[0]!; h.Items[0]=null; return x.V==3 && h.Items[0]==null; }
public static bool MapEntryRetain() { Bag h=new Bag(); Item x=h.Map["k"]!; h.Map["k"]=null; return x.V==3 && h.Map["k"]==null; }
public static bool ListEntryShared() { Bag h=new Bag(); Item x=h.Items[0]!; Item y=x; h.Items[0]=null; x.V=7; return y.V==7 && x==y; }
public static bool RepeatedReplacement() { Holder h=new Holder(); List<Item> xs=[]; for(int i=0;i<5;i++){xs.Add(h.It!); h.It=new Item(){V=i+4};} return xs[0].V==3 && xs[4].V==7 && h.It!.V==8; }
public static bool InterfaceAlias() { InterfaceHolder h=new InterfaceHolder(); IItem x=h.It!; h.It=null; return x.V==3; }
public static bool GenericAlias() { GenericHolder<Item?> h=new GenericHolder<Item?>(); h.It=new Item(); Item x=h.It!; h.It=null; return x.V==3; }
public static bool StaticAlias() { StaticHolder.It=new Item(); Item x=StaticHolder.It!; StaticHolder.It=null; return x.V==3; }
public static bool NullVariable() { Holder h=new Holder(); Item x=h.It!; h.It=null; return h.It==null && x.V==3; }
public static bool NullList() { Holder h=new Holder(); List<Item> xs=[h.It!]; h.It=null; return xs[0].V==3; }
public static bool NullDictionary() { Holder h=new Holder(); Dictionary<string,Item> xs={"x":h.It!}; h.It=null; return xs["x"].V==3; }
public static bool SharedAliases() { Holder h=new Holder(); Item x=h.It!; Item y=x; h.It=null; x.V=7; return y.V==7 && x==y && h.It==null; }
public static bool RetainedMethod() { Holder h=new Holder(); Item x=h.It!; h.It=null; return x.Read()==3; }
public static bool ClearInHelper() { Holder h=new Holder(); Item x=h.It!; Clear(h); return x.V==3 && h.It==null; }
public static bool ReplaceVariable() { Holder h=new Holder(); Item x=h.It!; h.It=new Item(){V=9}; return x.V==3 && h.It!.V==9; }
public static bool Reattach() { Holder h=new Holder(); Item x=h.It!; h.It=null; x.V=7; h.It=x; return h.It!.V==7 && h.It==x; }
public static bool DetachedControl() { DetachedHolder h=new DetachedHolder(); Item x=h.It!; h.It=null; x.V=7; return x.V==7 && h.It==null; }
public static bool NoRetainedLocal() { Holder h=new Holder(); h.It=null; return h.It==null; }
public static bool RepeatedClear() { Holder h=new Holder(); Item x=h.It!; h.It=null; h.It=null; return x.V==3; }
public static bool RowVariable() { ComplexHolder h=new ComplexHolder(); ComplexItem x=h.It!; h.It=null; return x.V==3 && x.Values.Count==1 && x.Child.V==3; }
public static bool RowListMutation() { ComplexHolder h=new ComplexHolder(); ComplexItem x=h.It!; h.It=null; x.Values.Add(2); return x.Values.Count==2; }
public static bool NestedChildAlias() { ComplexHolder h=new ComplexHolder(); Item x=h.It!.Child; h.It=null; x.V=7; return x.V==7; }
public static bool NestedListAlias() { ComplexHolder h=new ComplexHolder(); List<int> x=h.It!.Values; h.It=null; x.Add(2); return x.Count==2 && x[0]==1; }
public static bool RowReplacement() { ComplexHolder h=new ComplexHolder(); ComplexItem x=h.It!; h.It=new ComplexItem(); x.V=7; return x.V==7 && h.It!.V==3; }
public static bool ParentReplacement() { Outer h=new Outer(); Item x=h.H.It!; h.H=new Holder(); return x.V==3; }
public static void Clear(Holder h) {h.It=null;}
